_comment: SYNTHETIC. Written by hand around no real receipt — the repo is public and a real receipt carries a card's last four and a loyalty number. Three photos of one strip, overlapping two lines at each seam, with TJ ORG BANANAS printed TWICE because two bunches were bought: the join must keep both. The sriracha rang up twice on ONE line with a count sub-row under it, so the golden pins a count > 1.
